Definition: commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses rôgez for commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger. It stands in Habakkuk 3:2, "…speech, was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work…", and in Isaiah 14:3, "…hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rôgez is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
